probes.name: Editorial Planner
probes.thesis: Calendar-first editorial planning with focused review of real cuts.
probes.layout: Wide monthly calendar, compact approval rail, restrained top navigation; dedicated vertical player and saved revision detail. Mobile becomes an agenda.
probes.typography: Georgia display and brand with native system sans controls and body.
probes.system: Warm neutral paper, deep green action and identity, amber review status.
probes.signature: The thumbnail enters the calendar cell and opens the exact saved video revision.
probes.risk: Serif display is distinctive but secondary metadata must retain strong contrast.
probes.compactEvidence: Rendered at 390x844; calendar switches to agenda, review stacks player and saved revision detail.

probes.name: Screening Room
probes.thesis: The actual cut is the primary object; approval is a screening decision.
probes.layout: Large two-film strip above the calendar, cinematic centered review. Compact screens retain two cuts and stack review.
probes.typography: Native sans with heavy compact headline, quieter operational detail.
probes.system: Charcoal viewing surfaces, lime approval action, amber pending status.
probes.signature: A screening queue presents actual vertical cuts before scheduling.
probes.risk: Calendar is below the fold; best for review-first work, weaker for a calendar-led interview.
probes.compactEvidence: Rendered at 390x844; calendar switches to agenda, review stacks player and saved revision detail.

checkpoints.findingsReview: Initial low-contrast muted copy was corrected from #788278 to #606c61 and rescanned. The cream surface is intentional editorial paper; sequential numerals are calendar dates, not marketing steps. Calendar/review scores 10/7 are advisory.

Dark viewing surface is intentional for actual cuts. Compact uppercase release labels support the screening context. Sequential numbers are calendar dates. Calendar/review scores 10/4 are advisory; calendar below fold is a deliberate tradeoff.

Initial low-contrast metadata was corrected from #7a8496 to #606b7f and rescanned. Compact workspace labels are intentional; sequential numbers are calendar dates. Calendar/review scores 6/0 are advisory; event density remains a production polish concern.

Calendar/review scored 13/7; paper cream and calendar numerals are intentional. FullCalendar weekday capitalization is functional. Fixed default white event text and yellow today fill by placing semantic CSS variables on the actual calendar root. Metadata meets contrast scan.

Calendar/Create/Review 13/11/7. Calendar numbers and uppercase weekdays are functional; paper is selected direction; Create icons denote workflow steps. No low-contrast finding. Concrete fixes and remaining small metadata, tablet density and repeated speaker posters are recorded in artifacts/design/review.md. Advisory self-review, not owner acceptance.

composition.observation: Real saved-video thumbnails appear in desktop calendar events. Phone agenda and stacked review retain reachable actions; 768px rail moves below month.

interaction.observation: Browser verified prepared import, cached product/link renders, playable video, approval, Monday schedule and labeled local upload receipt; tabs support keyboard navigation.
